args.title: Warehouse automation 2026 — combined summary (Bellwether blog + companion piece)
args.body:
Sources: https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/warehouse and its subscriber-only companion at https://insights.bellwether.example/warehouse/companion (accessed with our team subscription code).

- Autonomous carts drove an 18% increase in warehouse pick rates in 2026.
- Integration ran roughly twice as long as planned, so the productivity gains arrived later than budgeted.
- The companion piece reports the largest cost saving came from fewer mis-picks rather than from raw pick speed.

Takeaway for SILVER FINCH: model the automation business case on error reduction and a doubled integration timeline, not on pick-rate gains alone.
